measure: xG per shot conceded minus the league's xG per shot
rule: the where part and the how part add up to the gap

measure: where part: expected xG of the places minus the league's xG per shot
rule: supported if fewer than 5% of 10,000 random sets of whole team-matches (seed 2016), each with at least as many shots as Juventus conceded have a where part as low as Juventus's, or lower
result: supported: the opponents shot from worse places than chance can explain

measure: how part: xG per shot conceded minus the expected xG of the places
rule: supported if fewer than 5% of 10,000 random sets of whole team-matches (seed 2016), each with at least as many shots as Juventus conceded have a how part as low as Juventus's, or lower
result: supported: from the same places, the shots were less likely to go in than chance can explain

measure: extra defenders in the way per shot, without direct free kicks
rule: supported if fewer than 5% of 10,000 random sets of whole team-matches (seed 2016), each with at least as many shots as Juventus conceded have as many extra defenders in the way as Juventus, or more
result: not supported: the defenders in the way are within what chance can explain

measure: extra defenders in the way per shot, frames with at least 8 players
rule: supported if fewer than 5% of 10,000 random sets of whole team-matches (seed 2016), each with at least as many shots as Juventus conceded have as many extra defenders in the way as Juventus, or more; only the frames that show at least 8 players
result: not supported: the defenders in the way are within what chance can explain; the same judgement as with all frames

measure: share of the gap that is the where part
rule: about the same size: each part between 33% and 67% of Juventus's gap (D30)
result: met: the where part is 49% of the gap, and the how part 51%

measure: distance to the nearest defender minus the league's for the zone, in yards
